verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AvaTax exposes versioned APIs: its SDKs target the 'REST v2 APIs'. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle commitments, so only the versioning half of the story is thinly evidenced. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning and changelog documentation, migration guidance between versions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Avalara provides SDKs for the REST v2 APIs in the following languages: C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby
